sloka: वारितान् राक्षसान् दृष्ट्वा मकराक्षो निशाचरः।क्रोधानलसमाविष्टो वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.७९.९ ।।
transliteration: vāritān rākṣasān dṛṣṭvā makarākṣo niśācaraḥ।krodhānalasamāviṣṭo vacanaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 6.79.9 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the intercepted Rakshasas, the night ranger Maka raksha was overtaken by fire of anger spoke these words.
